title: 第5章 震惊的林天海禁地天云海第6章 帝级功法震惊众人
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 林轩自然不知道林天海的想法，也不在意，而是开始按照自己提前编好的借口，讲述了起来。
毕竟如果他不找个理由，那些至宝的来历不好解释啊。
“父亲，在一个月前……”
随着林轩的叙述，原本一脸淡定从容的林天海，脸色开始变得越来越精彩起来。
“事情的全部经过，便是这样了……”
直到许久之后，随着林轩的话音落下，此时林天海已经由一开始的淡定从容，变为了震惊和不可置信。
只见林天海一脸震惊的看着林轩，开口道：
“轩儿，你是说你在一个月前，意外进入了一个无上大能的传承之地，然后被那位无上大能看中并赐予了传承，只是这个传承只有你修为不断提高，才能逐步解封，获得传承里的宝物，而你此次修为突破传承解封了一些，因此你获得了几样宝物……”
“嗯，大概便是父亲你理解的这样。”
林轩心虚的点了点头。
这已经是他所能想到的最好的借口了，虽然听起来是有那么一点“玄幻”……
但修炼界无奇不有，像这样气运逆天获得大能传承的事，又不是没有发现过，林天海虽然没有见过，但也听过不少，因此也仅是略微怀疑，并没有深究。
转而向着林轩，询问道：
“那轩儿，你如今的修为……”
因为系统遮蔽了林轩的境界，所以林天海并未看出林轩的真实境界，只能询问林轩。
在发现探查不到林轩的境界时，林天海内心其实也是非常震惊的。
毕竟按理说以他大圣境的修为，去看一个洞天境的小辈，理应一眼看穿才对，可是在他这儿子身上，他的神识却什么都探查不到，仿佛陷入了一片混沌之中似的。
这种情况，他可是只有在面对那些境界远超他的强者大能身上，才会出现的啊。
这臭小子又怎会如此………
而对面的林轩面对自家父亲的询问，也是解除了系统的遮掩，展露出了他真实的境界。
顿时……
“什么！”
“法相境六重！”
“轩儿你突破法相境了？还突破到法相境六重！”
林天海彻底震惊住了。
在一个月前，他还清楚的记得自家儿子的修为还是洞天境四重的，结果才过一个月便突破到法相境了？而且还是法相境六重天！
这如何不让他震惊？
即使是南冥大陆这不知道多少年的岁月里，他也没听说有哪个天才，有如此快的修炼速度。
一个月提升一个大境界还要多……
这真的是正常人能办到的？
到此，林天海也开始有点相信，他这儿子是真的获得了无上大能的传承，不然修为怎会暴涨如此之多？
“如父亲所见，孩儿确实已经达到了法相境六重天。”
林轩对此也是直接承认了下来。
闻言，林天海愣了一下，旋即哈哈大笑道：
“哈哈哈，不愧是我林天海的儿子！”
“有轩儿在，我林家何愁不兴！”
看着自家父亲那一脸自豪的样子，林轩也不打搅，只是微微一笑，并未言语。
良久
林天海停下来后，又立马催促道：
content_en:
Lin Xuan naturally didn't know what Lin Tianhai was thinking and didn't care. Instead, he started to tell the story according to the excuse he had made up in advance.
After all, if he didn't find a reason, the origin of those treasures would be difficult to explain.
"Father, a month ago..."
As Lin Xuan narrated, Lin Tianhai, who was originally calm and calm, began to look more and more exciting.
"This is what happened..."
Until a long time later, as Lin Xuan's words fell, Lin Tianhai had changed from calm and calm at the beginning to shock and disbelief.
Lin Tianhai looked at Lin Xuan in shock and said:
"Xuan'er, you are saying that a month ago, you accidentally entered a place of supreme power's inheritance, and then you were favored by that supreme power and given the inheritance. However, this inheritance can only be gradually unsealed and you can obtain the treasures in the inheritance only if your cultivation level continues to improve. And this time, your cultivation level broke through the inheritance and you unblocked some, so you obtained a few treasures..."
"Well, that's probably what you understand, father."
Lin Xuan nodded guiltily.
This was the best excuse he could think of, even though it sounded a bit "fantasy"...
However, there are all kinds of strange things in the world of cultivation. It is not undiscovered that things like this, where luck is against the heavens and the inheritance of great power is obtained. Although Lin Tianhai has never seen it, he has heard a lot about it, so he was only slightly suspicious and did not delve into it further.
Turning to Lin Xuan, he asked:
"That Xuan'er, your current cultivation level..."
Because the system obscured Lin Xuan's realm, Lin Tianhai did not see Lin Xuan's true realm and could only ask Lin Xuan.
Lin Tianhai was actually very shocked when he discovered that Lin Xuan's realm could not be detected.
After all, it stands to reason that with his cultivation in the Great Saint Realm, he should be able to see through a junior in the Cave Heaven Realm at a glance. However, with his son, his consciousness could not detect anything, as if he was trapped in chaos.
This kind of situation would only occur when he faced those powerful men whose realms far exceeded his own.
How could this brat be like this...
Opposite Lin Xuan also lifted the system's cover when facing his father's questioning, revealing his true realm.
Suddenly...
"What!"
"Sixth level of Dharma Realm!"
"Xuaner, have you broken through to the Dharma Realm? You have also broken through to the sixth level of the Dharma Realm!"
Lin Tianhai was completely shocked.
A month ago, he still clearly remembered that his son's cultivation was still at the fourth level of the Cave Heaven Realm, but only a month later he broke through to the Dharma Realm? And it’s still the sixth level of Dharma Realm!
How could this not shock him?
Even in the Nanming Continent for who knows how many years, he has never heard of any genius who has such a fast cultivation speed.
It takes more than one month to reach a great level...
Is this really something a normal person can do?
At this point, Lin Tianhai began to believe that his son had really received the inheritance of supreme power. Otherwise, how could his cultivation have soared so much?
"As the father can see, the child has indeed reached the sixth level of Dharma Realm."
Lin Xuan also directly admitted this.
Hearing this, Lin Tianhai was stunned for a moment, then laughed loudly and said:
"Hahaha, you are worthy of being my son, Lin Tianhai!"
"With Xuan'er here, why should my Lin family be unhappy?"
Seeing the proud look on his father's face, Lin Xuan didn't bother him, just smiled slightly and said nothing.
